name: starts_at
label: Start time
help: An open time, such as a Start time from List open appointment times.

name: contact_id
label: Contact ID
help: An existing contact with a phone number. Enter a contact ID or a contact phone.

name: contact_phone
label: Contact phone
help: Used when no contact ID is given. For example, +14165550134. A 10-digit number is read as North American.

name: staff_id
label: Staff member
help: Book with this staff member. If left empty, someone who is free is picked.

name: sms_consent
label: Customer agreed to texts
help: Yes only if the customer agreed to get confirmation and reminder texts. Used only when the business texts from its own number.
